machine: MacBook Air M1, 7-core GPU, Chrome, native WebGPU/Metal adapter
measuredAt: commit 15f4fce (docs claim corrected to code space below); ablation driver revised after review

method.domain: sRGB code steps (0..255) computed from both backends' presented frames; the native frame is display-linear rgba16float converted through the sRGB transfer function, the WebGL frame is read as sRGB codes
method.note: This is a code-space statistic. It is NOT the harness's display-linear DISPLAY_TOLERANCE/STILL_TOLERANCE statistic and must not be quoted as passing those gates.
method.reference: unmodified WebGL pipeline, same model/environment/camera/pose, hidden canvas at the same physical size
method.session: one condition per fresh session; each row re-measured after the driver gained state restore

environment: 900x600, 4x MSAA, TAA modern preset, motion blur, 8-level bloom, GT7, dither, SMAA off, grazing clamp off, specular AA on

rows.toggles: geometry + glass + GT7 only (TAA, blur, bloom, dither off)

motionAndSizeCases.note: not a like-for-like pair: in the WebGL reference, msaaSamples=0 also removes the resolve pass, so glass is never composited on the decoded colour. The frames are expected to differ. Not a quality regression in the native backend.

notMeasured: independent camera orbit (the driver's orbit pose was a no-op until this commit and is not yet re-measured)
mid-sequence resize and non-1 DPR in the parity matrix
SMAA on (the native SMAA shader failed to compile on device; reworked after this run and not yet re-measured)
full-viewport (3360x1866) whole-pipeline comparison: creating a second high-resolution renderer froze the tab; see docs/webgpu-performance.md
